claim: City windows are texture, not geometry: masked-glass walls on street frontage run at most 0.011 per 1,024 units of frontage (one per ~93k units) in E3M1, DWE3M1 and DukCity. Facade geometry is coarse, one vertex per 1.4k-3.7k units of frontage, spent on corners, setbacks and doorway reveals; signs and fixtures are wall sprites at 0.03-0.26 per 1,024.
evidence: tools/mine_city_norms.py, facade section of knowledge/blood/references/city-norms.json: wall vertices 0.28-0.73/1024, masked glass 0.000-0.011/1024
use: Choose a facade tile with windows painted on for rhythm; spend walls on silhouette and doorways.

checked.how: Read knowledge/blood/references/city-norms.json per_map facade (E3M1, DWE3M1, DukCity1-4): masked_windows_per_1024 0.011, 0.003, 0.001, 0.0, 0.0, 0.002 (E3M1: 2 over 191,824 units, 1,024/0.011 = 93k); walls_per_1024 0.53, 0.73, 0.46, 0.28, 0.38, 0.49 (one vertex per 1.4k-3.7k); wall_sprites_per_1024 0.032, 0.258, 0.057, 0.098, 0.132, 0.173 (0.03-0.26). The corners/setbacks/reveals reading is the page's interpretation.
